# bridle

> the act of restraining power or action or limiting excess New curfew laws have bridled people's tendency to go out at night.

> anger or take offense.

> control or restrain


## Example

- *The hostess bridled at the tactless dinner guests who insisted on eating before everybody had gotten their food.*
